payload.claim: The comment claims saffron.cell.session 'is forbidden here' as the reason for copying its _SHA regex into a new _RESOLVED_SHA constant instead of importing it. That claim is false: saffron/task.py:54 already does `from saffron.cell.session import _SHA as _RESOLVED_SHA`, under the exact same alias, so importing that name into saffron/scheduler.py (which has no import cycle with saffron.cell.session) is already established practice in this codebase. This is a restated constant per the One-source rule ('A constant restated is yours even when the two values agree today'), justified by a comment that misstates why, and a gate cannot see either the duplication or the false justification.
